title: Sim/carry: an outside contour leaves full-height slivers at the stock's outer corners in the carried body (probe needed)

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

labels.name: P3
labels.description: Wrong behaviour a user hits, with a workaround; fix now

body:
Found while building pins for PR #1549 (#1530). Not yet probed; please confirm before fixing.

**Observation:** a 50 x 50 x 10 mm part in **60 x 60** stock, with a Setup 1 outside 2D Contour using a 15.24 mm (0.6 in) end mill down to Z 4. The carried stock body for Setup 2 (`rest::entered_body` dexel columns) kept roughly **1.5 mm triangles at the stock's four outer corners at full stock height**. That is why #1549's pins use 56 x 56 stock instead.

**Why it looks wrong** (an analysis from the other session): the contour's tool reaches about 15 mm from the part's corner, while the stock corner is only 7.07 mm from the part corner (5 mm per side), so the corners should be cut through. A full-height sliver there is a sim or carry gap, not true rest material. Either the contour's corner motion (an arc vs an extended corner) or the dexel carry at the stock's outer boundary columns.

**Probe first:**
1. Reproduce with 60 x 60 stock and dump the posted path around one corner.
2. Compute the swept tool disc at the stock corner analytically.
3. Compare with the carried body's columns there, and with the in-setup stock sim (not carried).

If the path covers the corner but the carried body keeps it, it's a carry or sim bug: in Setup 2 it can make a fixture or vise falsely collide, or report false rest. If the path really leaves it, it's a contour corner-motion issue.

**Done means:** the probe result is posted here. If a bug, a pin with the 60 x 60 case shows no full-height corner material after the contour, sim-verified, plus the fix.

Related: #1530, PR #1549 (pins work around it with 56 x 56 stock).
